title: The Islands
content: Recently I've been ending up in this place that's a bunch of small islands separated by warm looking water. The beaches seem to be rather steep with small sand bars if there are any. If you look out into the more open water there is a giant dark iceberg floating in the water, a lot of the time I find people standing on the beaches looking at it like a tourist attraction. It's a strange dream, but it gives me the same kind of vibes I get when I'm in mall world. Let me know if you've seen something similar to this. ( I generated a quick image for reference)
